description: With its cutting-edge mining beam and expanded cargo capacity, the Aphelion is one of the strongest Independent miners on the market today, especially among those brave enough to venture into the Margins or the Veil. Its proprietary shielding technology minimizes the dimensional interference that plagues these areas, making it consistently punch above its class.

ship_ability.title: All Mine!
ship_ability.description: +{value} Crysal, Gas, and Ore Mining Speed.
